items.description: Consolidated four duplicated punch-in / punch-out implementations (header controls, workstation modal, workstation view and the 4-hour timeout effect) into a single useWorkstation hook. Session start, settle, timeout and cloud sync now share one code path.
Replaced the unresolved framer-motion import with motion/react, which previously crashed the app under strict package managers.
Unified the package.json version with the runtime APP_VERSION so the in-app update checker can no longer drift.
Stabilized the workstation hook callbacks with a state ref, so the 4-hour timeout interval is no longer torn down and rebuilt on every render.

Added a top-bar status chip using the user's own location icon: grey when idle, coloured while on duty, click to check in or out. Shows the day total on wide screens. The duplicated Check In / Desk Log controls were removed from the Explore header.

The check-in popover now exposes a Manage entry that opens the location editor. Extracted it into a shared ManageLocationsModal, and added a confirmation step with explicit data-loss warning before resetting to the three defaults.

Durations now render with a bold number and a lighter, smaller unit (e.g. 1h30m) via a shared DurationText component. Applied to the Sanctum today card, Record overview cards, weekly heatmap totals and Journal day summary.

Added a render-error boundary around the whole app and around the active page. A crashing view now shows a recoverable panel (try again / reload / export data) instead of a blank screen, and the sidebar keeps working.
